findings.title: Preserve panel right alignment in the legacy flexbox fallback
findings.body: The new `flexbox()` mixin falls back to `display: -webkit-box`/`-moz-box`, but those legacy box layouts treat auto margins as zero. In browsers selecting that fallback, removing `float: right` and relying on `margin-left: auto` leaves the header panel immediately after the logo/topic title instead of at the right edge. The dropdowns are positioned relative to that panel with `right: 0`, so the wide search dropdown can consequently extend off the left side of the viewport. Provide equivalent legacy-box spacing, or preserve the float layout for those browsers rather than enabling this fallback.
